name: London Project affiliate footer standard v9 - three official company logos then Coupang cards
selection_principles: Every affiliate-eligible article ends with one footer module; never insert it at the top or between paragraphs.
At the absolute end of every blog post, place three official company logo banners in one horizontal row: Coupang, OLIVE YOUNG, Trip.com.
Each banner uses the destination's own approved affiliate tracking URL; the displayed image must be the official company logo asset.

Immediately below the three-logo row, show the ten verified Coupang Partners product cards with product images and account-generated tracking links. The three-logo row and all ten cards form one footer block at the very bottom of the post.
Use fewer than ten cards only when fewer verified destination-specific products are available; never fabricate links or images.
Preserve article body, status, publication date, featured image and SEO metadata; update only the managed affiliate footer.
Disclose affiliate relationships clearly and never promise commissions for every click or purchase.

footer_logo_branding.trip_com_and_olive_young: Clickable tracked logo links to their approved landing pages
footer_logo_branding.coupang: Official Coupang Partners logo; use separate tracked text link if required by brand terms
footer_logo_branding.logo_assets_rule: Use image files of the official company marks, not text-only substitutes, emoji, or recreated wordmarks.
